verdict.rationale: Unreal ships genuine automation surfaces — the Unreal Automation Tool for unattended build/test runs, Python editor scripting for repeatable tasks, command-line/commandlet launches for headless execution, and a Remote Control API (WebSocket/HTTP) that lets external processes drive the engine — all of which can be wired into background/cron-style pipelines. However, none of this is framed as AI-native agent orchestration; it's general build/test/editor automation infrastructure that a developer must assemble themselves, and there's no first-party 'agent' or scheduler concept. missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent/automation scheduling feature, first-party examples of persistent background AI automations, independent hands-on confirmation of these automations running unattended reliably.
